title: Deploying Active Directory Domain Services
summary: I prepared a Windows Server VM, installed AD DS, promoted DC01 into a new forest and configured its static network settings.

title: DHCP & Windows Deployment Services
summary: I authorized DHCP, configured a lab scope and used WDS to boot and deploy a Windows 10 client over the virtual network.

title: Active Directory accounts & access controls
summary: I organized users and groups, tested logon restrictions and separated morning and evening folder access with share and NTFS permissions.

title: Windows storage & software RAID
summary: I attached virtual disks, initialized them and built striped, mirrored and RAID 5 volumes in Windows Disk Management.

title: RRAS VPN, NAT & connection accounting
summary: I configured a dual-adapter RRAS lab, set NAT and access policy, corrected a client hostname error and checked the connected VPN session.

title: Adding a domain controller & checking replication
summary: I joined DC02 to the lab domain, promoted it with DNS and Global Catalog and checked replication with repadmin.

title: Two-way external domain trust
summary: I configured reciprocal DNS forwarding, created a non-transitive external trust and tested cross-domain share access.

title: A two-node IIS Network Load Balancing lab
summary: I configured an NLB cluster with a shared virtual address and labeled IIS pages to identify the responding server.

title: Nested ESXi & virtual infrastructure troubleshooting
summary: I ran ESXi inside VMware Workstation, created a Windows Server guest and investigated virtual networking and datastore failures.
